title: Job Numbers and Last Week’s Tech/Crypto Rout
summary: Policy restraint, a failed Bitcoin floor and financing risk.
assessment: The near-term no-cut call is supported, and the report candidly retracts the Bitcoin bottom view. AWK’s actual entry subsequently performs well. The Strategy reserve critique identifies a real liquidity issue, while attributing the selloff to sentiment remains unproven. Gold-versus-dollar reserve comparisons need tighter denominators.

claims.claim: Inventories and import reductions cushion oil disruption.
claims.reason: EIA subsequently confirmed Chinese crude imports below 8mb/d in May and June; IEA reported large combined China/Japan import reductions. This supports the buffering mechanism, while the exact division between inventory draw and final-demand destruction remains uncertain as the source acknowledges.

evidence.title: China’s crude imports declined
evidence.finding: Imports fell below 8mb/d in May and June 2026, the first such readings since 2016.

claims.claim: Gold has surpassed dollar reserve holdings.
claims.reason: Gold’s market value exceeded foreign official Treasuries in late 2025, but Treasuries are not all dollar reserves, and including U.S. gold makes the comparison asymmetric. Valuation gains dominate the headline; by June ex-U.S. gold was again below Treasuries. The dollar/treasury shorthand is materially misleading.

evidence.title: Gold versus Treasury reserve measurement
evidence.finding: End 2025 world gold $5.1tn and ex-U.S. gold $4tn exceeded foreign official Treasuries $3.9tn, largely through valuation. By June 2026 ex-U.S. gold was below Treasuries again.

coverage_note: Full numbered text and image inventory read. All material theses across macro, digital assets, investment analysis and concluding sections considered. Position listings and incidental descriptive statistics are excluded unless they support a thesis.
framework_lessons: Liquidity runway matters even when asset backing is large.
verification_limitations: Current page snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date version.
A missing horizon is not replaced with an invented author deadline.
Market sensitivities use vendor adjusted closes and do not reconstruct portfolio execution.
